R11 (DEC-88) a reasoned act whose screen names a reasonField sends the member's own words in that field as its reason and asks no second one; with that field empty it sends nothing and says so

R11 an act that leaves the group carries mark.outward.means; one that does not, none

R12 before whoami answers, no act is drawn; an act the screen does not list is never drawn

R13 R61 a refusal of each kind (ok: false at the top level, in result, an HTTP error, no answer) is drawn beside the act it answers, never in place of the screen, an HTTP error without words naming no code; a form keeps what the member typed; nothing else changes
R21 an act's send: null sends nothing; {refuse: key} draws that word beside the act; a promise is awaited; done runs on success, then the reads named in rereads (all when absent)
R21 (K2999) a picked-rows act receives the picked keys as extra.picked; send may answer {query, raw}, the raw body sent as it is under the session header with no JSON content type
R21 (K2999) cs.download hands a byte answer to the browser as a file, its object address released once the download starts; a refusal answers {ok: false}

R21 (K3002) parts in view.parts, view.origin, a refusal word filled from the refusal's fields, a refusals function, {refuse, fills}, cs.value of a checkbox and a radio, cs.digest, cs.now, and no cs.open

R21 (K3011) a streamed answer (application/x-ndjson) reaches done and cs.call as its list of parsed events, the answer the last; a stream whose last event refuses is a refusal beside the act (control: a JSON answer reaches done as its result)
R11 (K3011) a read (an op OPS declares not mutating) carries no weight mark and runs on press, whatever op-grades' tables hold (control: a mutating act keeps its weight)

R33 a shared device at 15 minutes without the member's input sends signout and draws front's ended state; an act pressed is activity

R34 an act answered REAUTH_DUE opens the password dialog (session.reauth), sends reauth, and on success sends the act once more
R34 cancelling the password dialog sends nothing more; cs.reauth() answers whether the window opened
R33 (the harness for the screens' tests) clock.tickActive runs the page clock with the member's input every ten minutes: no lock and no sign-out over days; control: tick alone locks

R33 (K3156) activity counts only while a session record exists: with none (the public frame before sign-in) the member's input stores nothing, bio-session:active included; control: signed in, it is stored
